summary: Frontend-only regression + new-feature testing for GitHelp SPA. Focus on the new Error Finder module, voice buttons, and framer-motion refactor. All navigation, Error Finder diagnosis flow (keyword matching, example chip auto-fill+diagnose, no-match state, copy-fix), Command Explorer live search (24 -> 3 for 'undo'), Chatbot user+bot bubbles, Home hero+module cards, /errors direct URL, 404 with working 'Back to Home', all pass. Voice button renders on both Commands and Chatbot pages (Chromium test browser exposes SpeechRecognition). No console errors from framer-motion animations.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Error Finder returns up to 3 sorted matches; 'fatal: not a git repository' -> best match err-1 with fix line 'git init'. Non-fast-forward text matches err-3 with 'git pull --rebase'. Gibberish 'hello world foobar' correctly shows [data-testid=error-no-match]. Example chip test-ids are truncated to first 8 chars: e.g. 'error-example-fatal:-n'. Voice-button appears in Chromium (SpeechRecognition supported); it is intentionally null in browsers without support. Copy-fix uses navigator.clipboard, may fail silently in headless contexts but does not crash.
